[Problem]{.card-kicker} **shortest nested intervals on a tree** [AC abc240_e · Ranges on Tree](https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc240/tasks/abc240_e)

Two leaves have disjoint non-empty subtrees, so they need two different positive numbers. The maximum is at least the number of leaves. Numbering the leaves $1, 2, \ldots$ in the order a DFS finishes them, and giving every vertex the block of leaf numbers inside its subtree, meets that bound. Entry times of every vertex are also nested, but their maximum is $N$, which is larger whenever the tree is not a single path of leaves.

[Solved in full in @sec-tv-p1-ranges.]{.card-link}

:::
